Open the deck [in its own tab](../../slides/eu-frames-short.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: `[` and `]` jump between the two halves, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title. The deck has no optional runs, so every slide is shown. The [live deck](../../live/eu-frames-short.html){target="_blank"} is the same session with the cells of Tasks 1, 3 and 4 on its slides, so that the tasks run inside the deck; it loads R into the browser when it is opened, as the lab does.
